label: Area-array bump count
subgoals: Divide each die dimension by the bump pitch
Floor each quotient and multiply them
Reserve the power and ground share of the bumps

label: Area array against perimeter
subgoals: Count the full array as n squared
Count the outer ring as four times n minus one
Divide to get the area-array advantage

label: BGA ball maps
subgoals: Divide the package side by the ball pitch
Square the grid and subtract the depopulated block
Assign outer rows to signals that must escape
